name: What are the potential benefits of building an ADU on my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the potential benefits of building an ADU on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an ADU can offer several advantages. It can provide additional housing for family members, offer a dedicated workspace, or generate rental income to offset mortgage costs. ADUs can also increase your property value. They offer flexibility for changing family needs and can be a cost-effective alternative to purchasing a larger home or moving.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits of an ADU include extra housing, dedicated workspace, rental income, increased property value, and flexible living solutions.
